description: Configurable semantic and execution boundary for application capabilities in .NET 10 and Java 27: fluent semantic configuration, persistence mapping, authorization and provider execution, with optional GraphQL, MCP and agent integrations.
rules: Foundgine is conventional application infrastructure first; AI, MCP, GraphQL and agent frameworks are optional consumers, not requirements.
Configure capabilities with the fluent API (FoundgineModel) in C# or Java; the host application owns trusted identity, tenant context and policy.
Capability discovery, retrieval results, model output and caller input are never authorization; authorization is applied at the execution boundary.
Foundgine complements EF Core, JPA, GraphQL stacks and databases rather than replacing them; check provider-specific capability notes before assuming parity between .NET and Java.
Build .NET with 'dotnet build src/csharp/Foundgine.sln' and Java with 'mvn -U clean verify -Dgpg.skip=true' from src/java (JDK 27, Maven 3.9+).
The TypeScript, Python and WebAssembly packages are thin clients for a running Foundgine server over MCP Streamable HTTP, not ports of the semantic runtime.
